facts.why: The shop in the film is Joe's Pizza. Mr. Aziz is the owner, not the name on the sign. The badge, the headline and the coupon all say AZIZ'S.
The film gives Joe's Pizza no founding year. The real Joe's Pizza on Carmine Street opened in 1975 per Wikipedia, so 1962 is invented.
Mr Aziz calls it 'Joe's 29-minute guarantee' and refuses to pay for the late pizzas.

facts.text: LATE AGAIN 31 MINUTES. PIE IS FREE.
facts.why: The film's guarantee is 29 minutes and Peter is told to do 42 blocks in 7 and a half minutes. No 31 minute figure is said.
facts.fix: LATE AGAIN PARKER. PIE IS FREE.

facts.text: A stack of pies, one bungee cord, 42 blocks.
facts.why: The 42 blocks is right, but no bungee cord holds the pies in the transcript or plot.
facts.fix: A stack of pies, 42 blocks, 7 and a half minutes.

facts.text: from the cart on Peter's walk to class
facts.why: No knish cart appears in the transcript or plot, and a search found nothing either. Peter does juggle jobs and class.
facts.fix: a quick bite on the run between jobs

vibe.verdict: Cheerful pizza coupon sheet built on the delivery run, but the shop name is wrong and the big moments from the film are thin.
